name: Pyrebrand
notes: In game (hwp_wlk_pyrebrand, tested): brands the enemy nearest the aim; the recast (free while a brand is up) or the brand running out sets off the Hellfire Claw: base + the stored damage as fire within 40. A victim that dies passes the brand on within 100; with nobody there the brand is gone and the full cooldown starts. Assumed: the base 20-40, the brand's 6 s, the claw radius 40, the transfer range 100, the aim cone, the free recast.
summary: Brand an enemy with a demonic sigil. For a short duration, a portion of the damage you deal to that enemy feeds the brand. When you reactivate the ability or the brand expires, a Hellfire Claw tears up through the victim dealing fire damage based on the stored offering. If the victim dies before the brand is triggered, the brand transfers to a nearby enemy, carrying its stored damage.
